meta.title: Wikidata populations of the Natural Earth admin-1 units
meta.source: Wikidata, population (P1082): the best-ranked statement with the latest point in time (P585), the larger on the same date
meta.schema: items: {Wikidata item: [population, year or null, the one item that replaced it when the figure is that successor’s]} for the units whose Natural Earth wikidataid is theirs alone; codes: {ISO 3166-2 code: [population, year or null, Wikidata item]} for the others with a code of their own (P300); an item whose codes are all another country’s is set aside, as is a region or province keyed to a unit of a city kind when a city of the unit’s name is found instead; names: {Natural Earth adm1_code: [population, year or null, Wikidata item]} for the rest matched by name among their country’s units (located in the country or a step down, with a population, of the unit’s kind, no bare settlement, not inside a unit of the level, and, for an administrative unit, at the level of the country’s keyed units, else of a class with members enough for the country’s units of that kind and not three times too many; an exact label first, one naming the kind before a bare one, then one with the administrative words folded away, of the unit’s own kind, directly in the country); an item two units name goes to the one whose name GeoNames agrees with, else to neither; a unit whose own item was replaced by several is not asked. Every figure is the best-ranked statement with the latest date, unless that figure is ×jump.factor or more against the median of the item’s dated figures of the jump.memory years before with one within jump.years: then the latest figure before the jump stands (the count is of other bounds or another place)
